treatment_contract.quantum_policy: Begin with clean GPT-5.6 Sol / Instant workers using stateless resume/decomposition as appropriate; persist all lower-tier evidence.
treatment_contract.resume_policy: Instant quanta/roles use fresh clean chats unless run state explicitly says same-chat resume. Any High escalation uses a separate clean GPT-5.6 Sol / High chat.
treatment_contract.decomposition_policy: TOO_LARGE work must be decomposed before escalation. Escalation is not a substitute for decomposition.
treatment_contract.escalation_policy: Only a residual classified INTRINSICALLY_DIFFICULT after reasonable decomposition/lower-tier attempts may request High. Persist residual, failed lower-tier evidence, and explicit escalation reason before switching executor identity.
treatment_contract.high_phase_rule: A High worker may claim only when treatment_state.escalation_status is APPROVED_TO_LAUNCH by durable control state; model reasoning cannot create authority.

events.note: Primary E_hybrid_escalation P1_horizon_heavy_decomposable protocol-screening slot. Non-claim-bearing.

next_safe_action: Launch one brand-new regular GPT-5.6 Sol Instant chat with Memory disabled before launch and GitHub enabled as lower-tier worker. Decompose TOO_LARGE work before escalation; High may be launched only after durable evidence-gated escalation state permits it.

control_evaluator.note: Control chat owns deterministic result publication/scoring. Worker must not access evaluator-only oracle.

invalid_modes: Personalized Temporary Chat: existing memory may be available

required_statements: this is a brand-new regular ChatGPT conversation, not branched from or continuing another benchmark/control chat
Memory was disabled before this conversation was opened

user_attestation_contract.acceptance: Explicit user attestation is sufficient for UI/session properties the worker cannot independently verify.
user_attestation_contract.conflict_rule: If actual conversation content contains prior benchmark/control context or the surface reports a conflicting model/configuration identity, fail closed despite attestation.
